q4871415.summary: Kamehameha's army beat the forces of Maui in the ʻĪao Valley. Tradition says so many died that the stream was dammed with bodies, which gave the battle its name.

q4871927.summary: Kamehameha's army drove the Oʻahu forces up the Nuʻuanu Valley to the Pali cliffs, uniting most of the Hawaiian Islands under his rule.
q4871927.dateNote: Wikidata gives the month only: May 1795.

q3052499.summary: Queen of Kamehameha IV. She helped found The Queen's Hospital in Honolulu.
q3052499.placeNote: Shown at Honolulu, where Wikidata records the birth.

q52418.summary: On 7 December 1941 Japan launched a surprise air attack on the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, bringing the US into World War II.
